title: Functors out of a product precategory are the functors into the functor precategory
author: The Univalent Foundations Program
work: Homotopy Type Theory: Univalent Foundations of Mathematics

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 899-905 (book Lemma 9.5.3): for precategories A, B, C the type of functors from the product of A and B to C is equivalent to the type of functors from A to the functor precategory of B and C. The statement gives the two types and nothing else, and the proof (source lines 906-923) has to build both directions: on the one hand it must produce, from a functor on the product, its fibres at each object of A together with the natural transformations induced by the morphisms of A; on the other hand it must define the action on pairs of morphisms and notice that the two candidate composites agree by naturality of the given functor; and finally it must observe that the two constructions are inverse. The author explicitly defers the functoriality checks and the inverse verification as easy or clear, which this card records verbatim, so what is counted is the pair of constructions and the naturality observation, not those routine verifications.
